systems.system: Electronic payment system for traffic fines
systems.country_label: electronic payment system for traffic fines
systems.platform: payment through commercial banks (National Bank of Malawi, FDH Bank) and mobile money (TNM Mpamba, Airtel Money)
systems.tiers: Scheduled to become operational at Police Headquarters in Lilongwe and across the six police regions in the week of 4 September 2026

note: Electronic payment of traffic fines only: one function, and a payment channel for the public, not a station record, so no fact.
